data.title: 伊井野弥子 · 银杏大道上的林荫漫步
data.description: 深秋金黄落叶铺满的林荫大道上，弥子穿着双排扣卡其风衣，怀抱公文夹走在飘落的银杏雨中，露出端庄典雅的温和浅笑。
data.action: walking with folder, golden leaves falling, serene nostalgic smile
data.lighting: gentle autumn sunshine filtering through radiant yellow ginkgo canopy
data.promptProse: Strolling down a university promenade showered in golden ginkgo leaves wearing a chic autumn trench coat, Iino Miko carries a file folder close to her chest with a gentle, nostalgic smile.
data.animaCaption: Miko walking down a golden ginkgo promenade with a nostalgic smile.
